_comment: DRAFT 2026 event config. Run it with JDCVO_CONFIG=event_2026_draft.json; the deployed app keeps using event_2026.json (still 2025 data) until we swap this in. google_sheet_key is deliberately EMPTY so test runs write local JSON only and can never publish fake scores to the real 2026 sheet.
_comment_handicaps: full = every stroke the handicap says (floor(H/18) on every hole plus one more on the H mod 18 hardest). A 30 gets 30. The old notebook 'capped' rule (max 1/hole) is no longer used.
_comment_rounds: Schedule as circulated 2026-07-27. scrape_url values are PLACEHOLDERS, not real PlayThru events - they only need to be non-empty so the pipeline reads saved scores instead of skipping the round. Replace each with the real eid URL when the events exist.
